title: DeepMind agents prove Signal's core code secure, a first at machine-code level
summary: Google DeepMind's AlphaProof Code generated about 6.5 million lines of machine-checked Lean proofs showing that the compiled AArch64 code of libsignal, Signal's reference implementation, preserves forward secrecy, authentication and post-compromise security. The work, described on 10 November, is the first formal verification of protocol-level guarantees against the unmodified code of a widely deployed cryptographic library, and it took four weeks rather than years. Reintroducing two previously fixed bugs made the proofs fail.
